title: A Classification of Order Convergence via a Transfinite Fatou Hierarchy
summary: We investigate the descriptive complexity of order convergence in separable Banach lattices. While uniform convergence is Borel and $σ$-order convergence is known to be ${\bf Δ}^1_2$, it is unclear in general when $σ$-order convergence is analytic. We introduce a transfinite hierarchy of weakenings of the classical Fatou property, indexed by countable ordinals, and show that it provides a complete structural classification of this definability problem.
